title: Who Has Shown Me The Perfect, Supreme
summary: The shabad does not leave seva at diagnosis. It turns toward return.
takeaway: who has shown me the Perfect, Supreme Lord God
lifeApplication: Do one hidden act of service that does not return to self-advertisement. After the reaction, make the next return smaller and truer.

source.shortMeaning: Those whose hearts are filled with their Lord and Master; who has shown me the Perfect, Supreme Lord God
source.lifeApplication: Return begins when the later line is allowed to outlast the first rush of feeling.

evidence.coreClaim: Those whose hearts are filled with their Lord and Master; who has shown me the Perfect, Supreme Lord God
evidence.turn: Seva steadies when who has shown me the Perfect, Supreme Lord God.
evidence.practicalImplication: Do one hidden act of service that does not return to self-advertisement. After the reaction, make the next return smaller and truer.
